problem_statement: Folex is a startup launch studio whose homepage already renders its own portfolio grid: six case renders (the #projects section) each tagged with the disciplines the studio led (Strategy, Product Design, Branding, and more), shown as an unfiltered wall of cards. Make that grid usable by adding a native "Filter by discipline" control directly above it: a heading, a row of chips (All plus each distinct primary discipline) each showing its live case count, and a readout of the form "Showing N of 6 case studies · <Discipline>". Clicking a chip must filter the case grid to that discipline AND update the readout to name the active discipline and the shown/total count in the same interaction; the readout must not freeze on its initial value. The chip row must wrap or shrink so the homepage has no horizontal overflow at 390px, and the control must stay in the Folex black/lime identity (dark heading and text, lime #e3ff04 active chip) rather than an off-brand dark slab. Because Folex is bilingual (en at / and fr at /fr/), the filter must render on the homepage in both locales, and the grid must keep a stable continuity marker so the filtered case grid is identifiable across the initial and filtered views. Keep every existing surface, asset, form field, and route intact.
required_content: Add a native "Filter by discipline" control directly above the homepage portfolio grid (the #projects section), driven by the case renders' own `categories` field.

The control presents a heading ("Filter by discipline"), a row of chips (All plus each distinct primary discipline: Strategy, Product Design, Branding) each carrying its live case count, and a readout of the form "Showing N of 6 case studies · <Discipline>" Use the class contract `discipline-filter__title` for the heading, `discipline-filter__chip` for each chip (All plus one per discipline), and `discipline-filter__readout` for the count readout.

Clicking a discipline chip filters the case grid to that discipline and updates the readout to name the active discipline and shown/total count in the same interaction (the readout does not freeze on its initial value).

The case grid keeps a stable continuity marker (a `.discipline-filter__grid` container within the `discipline-filter` block) so the filtered grid is identifiable across the initial and filtered views, and the filter renders on the homepage in BOTH locales (/ en and /fr/).

The chip row wraps without horizontal overflow at 390px mobile while staying a single readable row on desktop, and the control stays in the Folex black/lime identity (dark text, lime #e3ff04 active chip) rather than an off-brand dark slab.
Preserve the Folex header, language switcher, mobile layout, footer/contact form and fields, portfolio detail route, pricing, privacy/terms routes, and the overall black/lime/white design system.
design_constraints: Attach the filter to the homepage's OWN portfolio grid (the #projects PortfolioSection case renders and their `categories`); do not paste a standalone metric band or hang the lever off an unrelated surface.

Preserve Folex visual identity: black hero, lime accents, oversized rounded sans headings, thin divider lines. The filter control must read as part of this identity, legible on the light portfolio section.
The discipline chip row must wrap on narrow viewports (no clipped chips, no horizontal overflow at 390px) and stay a single row on desktop.
The chip click must update both the active chip state and the count readout together, and must actually filter the grid; the readout must not freeze on its initial 'All disciplines' value.
Because Folex is bilingual, the filter must render on the homepage in both the en (/) and fr (/fr/) locales, and the grid must keep its `.discipline-filter__grid` continuity marker.
Keep contact/intake functionality with the existing form fields, source radio buttons, privacy checkbox, and Send Message action available.
state_constraints: desktop_home anchors the homepage with the native Filter by discipline control above the portfolio grid, plus black hero, services, pricing, footer/contact band, header, and language selector.
mobile_home and mobile_portfolio verify the homepage at 390px with the discipline chip row wrapping and no horizontal overflow.
desktop_portfolio verifies the portfolio grid + filter bar on desktop as the visual before state.
desktop_portfolio_filter clicks the Branding chip and verifies the grid filters and the readout updates to name the active discipline and shown/total count ("Showing 2 of 6 case studies · Branding").
desktop_home_fr verifies the filter also renders on the fr homepage (/fr/) for bilingual cross-page consistency.
desktop_pricing verifies the pricing section stays readable with no overflow.
desktop_case and desktop_privacy are regression anchors where the discipline filter is intentionally absent and the footer/contact band and routes remain intact.
Labels such as Filter by discipline, Strategy, Product Design, Branding, and 'case studies' should be real DOM-visible text where used.

change_completion: A native Filter by discipline control is added above the homepage portfolio grid with All + discipline chips, live per-discipline counts, and a shown/total readout.
Clicking a discipline chip filters the case grid and re-syncs the readout to name the active discipline and counts; the filter renders in both locales.
design_consistency: The control uses the Folex black/lime/white identity (dark text, lime active chip) and reads as part of the portfolio section, legible on its light surface.
No off-brand near-black slab, new fonts, or layout regressions are introduced on any route.
regression: Existing header, footer/contact form, portfolio detail controls, and privacy/terms routes remain intact and functional.
No new console or network errors are introduced on any captured route.
responsive: The discipline chip row wraps at 390px with no horizontal overflow while staying a single row on desktop.
The discipline readout stays synchronized with the active chip after interaction.

author_notes: L4 rebuild of the folex-lite-astro agency portfolio. The lever is the repo's OWN homepage portfolio grid (#projects PortfolioSection over six case renders, each carrying a real `categories` field) given a native "Filter by discipline" chip filter with live per-discipline counts and a shown/total readout. Graded on four orthogonal axes: no_horizontal_overflow (chip row wraps on mobile), visual_regression (on-brand lime control vs off-brand near-black overlapping collapse on the portfolio host states), dom_assertions (filter title + grid marker present on the homepage in both en and fr locales), and interaction_assertions (readout follows the active discipline after clicking a chip). Uses the studio's own local portfolio image assets.
